ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISNEW(), OR(ISBLANK(ShippingStreet) , ISBLANK(ShippingCity) , ISBLANK(ShippingPostalCode), ISBLANK(ShippingState) ) ), AND( OR(ISBLANK(ShippingStreet) , ISBLANK(ShippingCity) , ISBLANK(ShippingPostalCode), ISBLANK(ShippingState) ), OR(ISCHANGED(ShippingStreet) , ISCHANGED(ShippingCity) , ISCHANGED(ShippingPostalCode), ISCHANGED(ShippingState) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shipping street, city, state and zip code must be entered before saving the record.
